title: P02 T11 fail-closed source security/privacy and PR merge-gate preparation
summary: Added source-based independent security/privacy contract tests and strict Windows CI audit for final M02/M19 P02 preview. This does not certify Narrator, all product states, hardware performance SLA, independent merge approval or release. All prior source security, Governance and real Windows CI passed on ac8b8ed5 (#45307557723), including warm IPC 864/891/891ms and cold metadata 40136ms (within CI budget, production outlier not resolved). Added read-only actual public Wiki Chrome DOM verification with historical published SHA comparison and immutable Git source file readback, corrected canonical Help/Wiki publication wording without mutating remote pages or enabling native external navigation. Exact-head new verifier must pass.
migration_notes: No changes to SQLite state, disk data, Rust privileges, user network connectivity or user files. Source-only CI regression and documentation. Rollback by reverting test/gate/doc commit.
